description: This dataset contains observations of the beetle species *Sphenophorus parvulus*, collected from various locations in the United States and Canada. The records include taxonomic classifications, geographic coordinates, observation dates, and metadata such as identifiers, licenses, and contributors. The semantic profile highlights biodiversity-focused attributes, including taxonomic ranks, spatial data (coordinates, uncertainty, and elevation), temporal filters (event dates), and attribution details (recorded by, identified by). The dataset is particularly useful for studying the distribution, habitat preferences, and temporal patterns of this beetle species, as well as for biodiversity research, ecological modeling, and conservation efforts. It also supports analyses of citizen science contributions and data quality issues.
